sentimento.text1: 📉 THE WINNER CONTRACT GAP NARROWED BY 1.00pp, from 6.45pp to 5.45pp, after widening for two days, and only one side did the narrowing: Lula rose from 45.50% to 46.50% (vol USD 11.11M accumulated) and Flávio Bolsonaro ended at the same 51.95% as yesterday (vol USD 10.73M accumulated), against the confirmed reading of Sep 14. ⚠️ In mid-afternoon the picture was different: the distance got 0.30pp narrower, and Flávio's side recovered the difference by the close of the reading. Neither price is an extreme: the 51.95% sits 3.15pp below Flávio's series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and the 46.50% sits 21.00pp below Lula's high, of 67.50% on Aug 16.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ TWO NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON Sep 15, AND THEY AGREE ON THE SIGN AND DISAGREE ON THE MAGNITUDE. Indexa/Broadcast (fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, 2,000 telephone interviews, margin of 2.2pp) gives Lula the first round by 38% to 34% and the runoff by 43% to 42%. CNT/MDA (fieldwork from Sep 9 to 13, 2,002 in-person interviews, same margin of 2.2pp) gives the first round by 40.5% to 30.4% and the runoff by 47.3% to 40%. ⚠️ Both put Lula ahead in both rounds, and the runoff distance is 1 point in one and 7.3 points in the other, a difference of 6.3 points between houses that measured practically the same days. In Indexa the pair fits inside the margin and is a statistical tie; in CNT/MDA it does not fit. The panel records both without choosing.
sentimento.text3: 📅 THE WEEK'S CALENDAR REMAINS CROWDED: the Superior Electoral Court register carries ten national polls with release dates after today, and five of them fall on Sep 17, from PoderData, Gerp, 100 Cidades, AtlasIntel and Datafolha. On Sep 18 the Veritá poll of 40,500 interviews is scheduled, and on Sep 20 two Palver waves. A register entry at the Court is a commitment to release, not a published number, and the panel only incorporates a poll once the house releases it.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 51.95% in the winner contract, the same value as the confirmed reading of Sep 14, 3.15pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the two national polls of Sep 15 he trails in both rounds, with 34% and 42% in Indexa/Broadcast and 30.4% and 40% in CNT/MDA. In the first-round runner-up contract he RISES 1.00pp, to 76.50%.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 46.50% in the winner contract, up 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of Sep 14, and 21.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the two national polls of Sep 15 he leads both rounds, with 38% and 43% in Indexa/Broadcast and 40.5% and 47.3% in CNT/MDA. In the first-round runner-up contract he falls 1.90pp, to 21.85%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury has 6% in the first round in both national polls of Sep 15 and rises 0.10pp in the winner contract, to 0.45%. Ronaldo Caiado has 4% in Indexa/Broadcast and 3% in CNT/MDA, and stays at 0.15% in the winner contract. Renan Santos has 3% and 2.7%, and slips 0.05pp, to 1.65%. 🔒 The first-round third-place contract receives no new price in this round, because its two readings did not agree: the values shown there remain those of Sep 14.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading of Sep 15, 16:37 BRT (19:37 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and certification is per contract: in this round the winner, first-round runner-up, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate contracts were confirmed, and the first-round third-place contract did not close the confirmation, so it keeps the value of Sep 14. Presidential book at USD 150.22M accumulated.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE INSS FRAUD INQUIRY ON Sep 15. What stands is still the act of Sep 12, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and on Sep 15 the Supreme Court plenary began judging the question that gave rise to that suspension. The judgment did not conclude on Tuesday.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval is still the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13: 43% approve, 50% disapprove and 7% do not know, and on the management scale 32% rate it positive, 27% average, 38% negative and 3% give no answer. The two national polls of Sep 15 do not carry approval figures confirmed in two independent sources, so the panel does not replace it.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is about assessment and calendar, not about an act: there is no new act in the INSS fraud inquiry on Sep 15, and the suspension that reaches those cases became the object of a plenary judgment on the same day.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 THE SUPREME COURT PLENARY BEGAN JUDGING ON Sep 15 WHETHER ALEXANDRE DE MORAES WILL BE INVESTIGATED over his connection to Daniel Vorcaro, and the judgment did NOT conclude. The session was opened at 10:52 by Edson Fachin, who is the rapporteur, was suspended and resumed at 15:00, with the plenary on points of order. Flávio Dino proposed moving the analysis to Sep 23, in a joint session with the André Mendonça case.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS, and it is not all from today: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur and suspended the cases; on Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered to the justices' offices the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone, André Mendonça lifted the seal on data about the Banco Master payments network, and Moraes filed with Fachin, that evening, a 121-point petition asking for the immediate extinction of the investigation, which he calls doubly void. ⚠️ Also on Sep 14, in the evening, the Federal Police rescheduled to Sep 24 the Vorcaro deposition that had been set for today, at the request of his defence, which argued it lacked full access to the case files. Vorcaro is held at Papudinha, in the Federal District.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the reading of Sep 15, 16:37 BRT. In that reading the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.95%, with USD 91 thousand accumulated, down 0.30pp against the 5.25% of Sep 14. ⭐ And the path within the day is the record that matters: at 14:44 the same contract stood at 8.05%, that is, it rose 2.80pp in the first half of the afternoon and gave it all back, and a little more, by 16:37. It is a book of USD 91 thousand accumulated since it opened, and a thin book moves on little money. The panel records both readings and does not attribute the move to the judgment.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 14 to Sep 15 is that the question left the individual office and went to the plenary, and nothing more: there is no decision, the judgment did not conclude, and the deposition that had been set for today was rescheduled to Sep 24. The panel records the procedure and the price, without saying which of the two better describes the outcome.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed in two independent sources on Sep 15. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On the evening of Sep 14 he filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate extinction of the investigation, which he classifies as doubly void and as a political-electoral deviation of purpose, and he denies having received messages from Vorcaro. On Sep 15 he is the object of the judgment opened in the plenary, which was not concluded.
stf.gilmar: On Sep 15 he stated that the judgment on Moraes should not conclude on Tuesday. On Sep 14 his office received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On Sep 15 he challenged Fachin in the plenary, arguing that the Court president could not have taken over the Moraes case, and asked for the judgment to be moved to a joint session with the Mendonça case, on Sep 23. On Sep 14 he had authorised the Federal Police's Operation Transparency 3 and lifted the seal on the case about the film Dark Horse.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 14 he lifted the seal on data about the Banco Master payments network, after a request from Fachin and a favourable opinion from the Prosecutor General's Office. On Sep 15 he replied to Fachin denying irregularities in the Federal Police report that identified Moraes as an interlocutor, and Flávio Dino proposed that his case be judged in the same session as the Moraes case, on Sep 23.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and of institution, not of outcome. The plenary opened on Sep 15 the judgment on the investigation of a justice, without concluding, and on the same day the contract that pays out if a Supreme Court justice leaves by impeachment before 2027 rose 2.80pp by 14:44 and gave back 3.10pp by 16:37, closing below the previous day. The panel records both readings side by side and does not claim the judgment caused either of them.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 CLOSED AT 4.95% (vol USD 91 thousand accumulated), reading of Sep 15, 16:37 BRT, down 0.30pp against the 5.25% of the confirmed reading of Sep 14. ⭐ The day's move was a round trip: in the certified reading of 14:44 it stood at 8.05%, 2.80pp above the previous day, and gave back the 3.10pp over the next two hours. ⚠️ It remains far from the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 2.85pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8. It is a thin book, with USD 91 thousand accumulated since it opened, and a thin book moves on little money.
stf.fachin: On Sep 15 he opened, as rapporteur, the plenary judgment on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, at 10:52, saying that "people are not judged; facts and legal questions are judged" and that "the decision belongs to the Plenary, not to an individual Justice". The session was suspended and resumed at 15:00, and the judgment did not conclude on Tuesday.
